summary: Merges one or more PDFs of a requisition into a single PDF

parameters.name: polling
parameters.description: When true, the response returns a `job_url` you can poll for async compilation status. When false or omitted, the compiled PDF is emailed to the requesting user and the response body is empty.

type.description: Kind of file to include in the merged output. Use `cover_sheet` to generate the requisition cover sheet, or `prostore_file` to include an existing attachment referenced by `id`.

id.description: ID of the file to include. For `prostore_file` entries this is the Prostore file ID; for a `cover_sheet` entry send an empty value since the cover sheet is generated on demand.

url.description: Optional source URL of the file to include, when the file is referenced by location rather than by stored attachment ID.
